attrs.scope: Founder thesis 'AGI = gather scattered frontier pieces into ONE SOCIETY, assemble not invent' (사회를 만드느냐, 흩어진 것을 모아서 하나의 AGI로). Three families: (F1) multi-agent SOCIETY (agent societies, role-differentiated planner/solver/critic, debate/reflection, specialist coevolution, A2A/ACP society infrastructure); (F2) ASSEMBLY/COMPOSITION of models & methods (model merging, mixture-of-agents, routing/ensembling, skill/tool composition, LLM-as-orchestrator); (F3) generative composition methods (diffusion reasoning/planning, flow matching, latent-program synthesis, workflow/agent distillation, retrieval/memory composition). CRUX contradiction preserved: multi-agent-helps vs multi-agent-loses-to-a-single-strong-model.

attrs.definition: Systems of many LLM-driven agents that interact, differentiate roles (planner/solver/critic), debate/reflect, coevolve into specialists, and communicate over agent-to-agent protocols — the 'society' the founder wants to assemble.

Composing scattered pretrained pieces into one capable system WITHOUT inventing a new model: weight-space merging, output-space mixture/ensembling, query-level routing, and skill/tool composition with an LLM orchestrator.

Cross-cutting generative methods used to compose and plan: diffusion for reasoning/planning, flow matching, latent-program synthesis/library learning, workflow/agent distillation, and retrieval/memory composition.

attrs.definition: The central D7 contradiction: whether a society of assembled agents beats one strong model, or the coordination tax and correlated failures make a single strong model (or CoT-Self-Consistency) win.
The Park et al. architecture that made LLM social simulation believable; the lineage anchor for agent societies.
Co-evolving models (via merging) and synthetic tasks to grow an archive of specialist experts (AC/DC, MAE, SAGE, SEAL).

Under identical inputs, multi-agent debate forms a martingale over beliefs — expected correctness does not rise with rounds; majority voting, not the debate structure, accounts for most measured gains.

entities.name: Agent interoperability stack (MCP / A2A / ACP / ANP)

attrs.definition: Society infrastructure: MCP (tool access), A2A (Google, cross-platform agent collaboration), ACP (IBM, edge/local), ANP (decentralized marketplaces). A2A donated to Linux Foundation 2025-06.
Weight delta (finetuned − pretrained) treated as a composable vector: add/negate/scale to assemble capabilities.
Naive summation of task vectors hurts; TIES/DARE exist to de-interfere (trim, sign-elect, drop-and-rescale).
Diversity helps only when component quality is held equal; adding weaker/heterogeneous pieces lowers average quality.
Ensemble accuracy is capped by 1 minus the rate all models fail the same query; combining rarely beats the single best model without a strong query-level routing signal.
Pick-one or direct-per-step across heterogeneous models (RouteLLM, FrugalGPT, AB-MCTS model selection).
Ever-growing library of executable, retrievable skills that compose into new behavior without weight updates.
Train a generative (diffusion/flow) model over trajectories and sample coherent long-horizon plans via denoising.
Grow reusable compositional symbolic abstractions (DreamCoder/LILO) — programs as composable skills.
Collapse a multi-step or multi-agent workflow into one smaller model or capsule — AIOS's own ASC-0284 negative sits here.
Composition quality lives in retrieval, not write-time processing; raw-chunk storage can match expensive extraction.

entities.name: Anthropic's orchestrator (Opus) + parallel subagents (Sonnet) beat single-agent Opus by 90.2% on an internal research eval — but at ~15x the token cost (Anthropic engineering blog, 2025-06).
Multiple LLM instances debating over rounds improve factuality and math/strategic reasoning and reduce hallucination (Du et al.).
AC/DC coevolves LLMs via model merging + synthetic tasks into an archive of small experts that surpass larger LLMs on capability coverage while using less GPU memory.

Across medical QA/VQA/EHR/workflow, multi-agent collaboration does NOT consistently beat advanced single LLMs and loses to specialized conventional methods on VQA/EHR; extra complexity must be justified.

MAS performance gains on popular benchmarks 'often remain minimal compared with single-agent frameworks'; failures are structural (14 modes / 3 categories), needing redesign not prompt fixes (kappa=0.88, 1600+ traces).

Self-organizing LLM teams fail to match their own best expert member — losses up to 37.6% — even when told who the expert is; the bottleneck is expert-leveraging (integrative averaging), not identification.
Automatically-generated multi-agent systems consistently underperform CoT-Self-Consistency despite up to 10x cost — 'architectural bloat' masked by evaluation frameworks.
Majority voting alone accounts for most of multi-agent debate's gains; under identical inputs debate is a martingale over beliefs, so debate itself does not raise expected correctness.
A single agent with strong prompting roughly matches the best multi-agent discussion; multi-agent only wins when no demonstration is in the prompt.
In compound inference (Vote / Filter-Vote), performance first rises then FALLS as the number of LLM calls increases — more calls can hurt.

Layered Mixture-of-Agents over open-source models scores 65.1% on AlpacaEval 2.0 vs 57.5% for GPT-4 Omni; LLMs generate better responses when shown others' outputs ('collaborativeness'), even from weaker models.
Evolutionary merging in parameter + data-flow space produced a 7B Japanese-math model (EvoLLM-JP, 55.2%) that surpasses some 70B models — assembling existing open models without training.
Multi-LLM AB-MCTS (o4-mini + Gemini-2.5-Pro + R1-0528) solves 27.5% of ARC-AGI-2 vs 23% for o4-mini alone by adaptively choosing wider-vs-deeper AND which model per step (Thompson sampling).
Pure sampling-and-voting scales with agent count: an ensemble of ~15 lets Llama2-13B approach Llama2-70B; gains grow with task difficulty.
Predicting an executable skill plan from (task, skill library) gives +23.1 / +18.2 pp over baselines on production coding agents (abstract-level numbers).

Self-MoA (aggregating samples from the single best model) beats mixed Mixture-of-Agents by +6.6% on AlpacaEval 2.0 and +3.8% avg (MMLU/CRUX/MATH); mixing weaker models lowers average quality — quality dominates diversity.

Ensemble accuracy is hard-capped at 1 - beta (beta = shared-failure rate, measured ~0.05-0.13, ~2.5x worse than independence); 'combining models rarely beats the single best model without a strong query-level routing signal' (single-author preprint, numbers UNVERIFIED beyond abstract).

Across 6 merging methods x 4 LLMs x 12 checkpoints x 16 benchmarks, Task Arithmetic is the ONLY method that reliably gains; interference-aware/subspace methods (TIES/DARE-style) give no notable gain over base in the wild.
Interference-aware merging (TIES trim+elect-sign; DARE drop-and-rescale of 90-99% of deltas) beats naive task arithmetic in-paper by removing destructive interference across tasks.
Learned strong/weak routing from preference data cuts cost >2x with no quality loss and transfers across model pairs; FrugalGPT cascades match GPT-4 at up to 98% lower cost.

An 8B masked diffusion LM trained from scratch (LLaDA) is competitive with LLaMA3-8B in in-context learning and instruction following — first strong evidence diffusion LMs rival autoregressive at scale.

Diffusion LMs consistently underperform on multi-step reasoning, but a training-free ~100-token AR-generated plan lifts LLaDA-8B GSM8K 75.6->87.2% (+11.6pp, matching same-size AR) — the gap is a coordination problem, largely closable with structure conditioning.
CoT distillation follows a power law in teacher/student/data, with a U-shaped regime where an OVER-capable teacher DEGRADES the student — the strongest teacher is not the best teacher.

Multi-agent debate dynamics can be distilled into ONE model's weights (reasoning-SFT + trajectory augmentation + process-aware training), keeping single-agent cost while gaining multi-agent self-correction.
On LoCoMo, the retrieval method dominates agent-memory quality (~20pt spread) while the write strategy barely matters (3-8pt); zero-LLM raw-chunk storage matches expensive Mem0/MemGPT extraction.

AIOS's own ASC-0284: distilling a multi-step agent 'runtime capsule' into a small local model (qwen3:1.7b) returned HONEST_NEGATIVE — B1(capsule) won 0/12 paired tasks, both arms 0/12 exact success, capsule increased scope violations 1->3. Workflow/capsule distillation did NOT transfer to a T1 substrate.
